title: Momentum Rotation gold ↔ S&P 500

preregistration.hypothesis: TF1c: dual momentum (Antonacci 2014) between gold and the S&P 500 – hold the one with the stronger risk-adjusted 60-day momentum if that momentum is positive, else stay flat – beats holding either one.
preregistration.why_these_parameters: Classic dual momentum uses 12 months; the Bybit perpetuals have ~6–8 months of history, so 60 days (360 × 4h) with 30-day volatility, a hysteresis band of 0.25 volatility units against flip-flopping, long only, 4×ATR catastrophic stop. Not fitted.
preregistration.decision_rule: As TF1a, against an equal-weight buy & hold of both instruments.
